name: Monster colors: Sproutle and Venomole
notes: Shared colors of Sproutle and Venomole's sprites and portraits: 1 = dark outline, 2 = white, 3-8 = Sproutle's light / mid / dark body colors and 3 accent colors, 9-14 = Venomole's, 15 = pink blush. Light comes from the top-left: light on the upper-left, dark low on the right.
